tests.name: Forward reference generation, fine step and seed reproducibility
Only observations cross into the inverse configuration
Manual edits change inverse results but not the reference trajectory
Empirical ellipse mean, covariance, area and membership have an analytic reference
Every candidate uses the same reference and labels cloud provenance
Batch failures retain the full denominator and omit bulky trajectories
Two axes, independent test seeds and unsupported calibration are explicit
Zero noise and unavailable first-flight observations do not fabricate uncertainty
All factories serialize in a Worker without external dependencies

scope: Small software fixtures, not paper experiments; no calibrated coverage or real-ball validation.
